offering_description.value: Green Brick Partners develops residential communities and builds single-family homes and townhomes for homebuyers. It acquires land, prepares lots for construction and sells homes through its local builders. It also sells developed lots to other builders and offers title, closing and mortgage origination services.

primary_products.value: detached single-family homes; townhomes; developed residential lots

primary_services.value: title and closing services; mortgage origination

customer_segment.value: B2C: buyers of newly built homes; B2B: homebuilders purchasing developed residential lots

end_markets.value: new-home sales; residential land development; home purchase financing and settlement

revenue_model.value: product sales: new homes and developed residential lots; service fees: title and closing services and mortgage origination

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds homes with purchased materials and subcontracted labor for homebuyers; other: acquires and develops land into lots for its own builders and third-party builders; service provider: handles title and closing for residential real estate transactions; financial intermediary: originates home purchase loans for buyers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; other; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: US regional: Texas, the Atlanta area and Florida’s Treasure Coast

specialization.value: related lines: homebuilding, residential lot development, title and closing, and mortgage origination

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: builder sales teams serving homebuyers and land development teams selling lots to builders; own locations: model homes and sales offices in residential communities; agents / brokers: independent real estate agents representing homebuyers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: local zoning, permits and building codes govern development and construction, while title and mortgage operations require licensing

notes: The current availability of title and mortgage services across individual markets is uncertain.
